retained_scope: Concise method metadata only; no quantitative outcome file or table

sequence_family_ancestry.factual_summary: The 2020 study reused the existing 2440-sequence, 171bp candidate-enhancer array from Inoue2017. Nested 192/354/678bp contexts and both orientations share source sequence families.
sequence_family_ancestry.short_source_quote: We used an existing array library from Inoue et al. This library consists of 2,440 unique 171 bp candidate enhancer sequences, based on ChIP-seq peaks in HepG2.

endpoint.replicate_normalization: The source scales RNA/DNA ratios by the median for each replicate before averaging, so contextwise processed outputs are not raw molecular abundances.

replicates.nine_designs: Most named designs have three matched DNA/RNA replicate labels in GEO.
replicates.length_and_orientation: ShortMedLong and forwardReverse have four DNA/RNA replicate labels.
replicates.source_exclusions: First replicates of 5prime/3prime MT and 3prime/3prime MT were excluded during averaging after technical resequencing data were pooled. Individual-replicate files and stated exclusions must be preserved.

inference_limit: A length change alters input sequence, and an assay-design change can alter both chromosomal location and transcription/translation architecture. Do not label every design contrast as an isolated cellular-context intervention.
